description: We’re Artemis to Ares, a team fascinated by the equipment humans have left behind on the Moon and Mars. Our project, “ The Silent Explorers ”, tells the stories of landers, rovers and stations from The Lunar Modules  to Ingenuity: how they worked, what they discovered, and how they ended. We’re building a research-based, visual website. We’re looking for people with skills in web design, writing, illustration, or space science, and anyone curious about space history.
